description: Provision an AWS Cloudfront Function via the ACK cloudfront controller. Fields mirror the cloudfront.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1 Function spec.

functionCode.description:
The function code. For more information about writing a CloudFront function,
see Writing function code for CloudFront Functions (https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/writing-function-code.html)
in the Amazon CloudFront Developer Guide.

functionConfig.description:
Configuration information about the function, including an optional comment
and the function's runtime.

name.description:
A name to identify the function.

Regex Pattern: `^[a-zA-Z0-9-_]{1,64}$`

region.description: AWS region for this resource (e.g. eu-west-1). Rendered as the services.k8s.aws/region annotation. Empty inherits the ACK controller's default region.
region.title: AWS region

title: AWS Cloudfront Function
